_comment: Known failures of the knx-sim flash-then-plan loop (scripts/sim-catalog-loop.sh, issue #346): application id to the step that fails first. A listed application that fails at another step, or passes, is reported; regenerate with --update-baseline.
source: shard 0/6 of 2026-10-25, loaded machine: incomplete; the nightly (sim-catalog-nightly.yml) fills it in

M-0083_A-0054-14-0D63.reason: `Switching times in the device` = 1 allocates the 0x47E4 AbsSegment in three parts (899 + 2966 + 578 of 5406 octets); bussard now streams each part into its allocation, but generated 2 also shows switching-time parameters that land in the 961 octets no allocation holds (ETS: "not transmitted", the device keeps its own), so the plan refuses as for a System B <choose> that writes a segment in part (#402, #413). Intended.

M-0083_A-0255-21-0ECA.reason: `Switching times in the device` (P-203) = 1 allocates the 0x4770 AbsSegment in two parts (2941 + 86 of 3112 octets); before #413 the whole image went into the first allocation and the read-back found 71 parameters differing. bussard now streams each part, but generated 2 also shows switching-time parameters in octets 2941..3010 that no allocation holds (ETS: not transmitted), so the plan refuses as for a System B <choose> that writes a segment in part (#402, #413). Intended.
